title: ProfileOutput
description: The one JSON document `trooth profile <domain|slug> --json` prints on stdout: a company's Trust Profile, section by section, read from GET https://trooth.co/api/network/profile?q=<domain>&contract=2 (schema https://trooth.co/schemas/network-profile.v2.schema.json). Each fact carries its value, who said it and its date when Trooth recorded one; a fact with no recorded date has date null, never a date borrowed from another field. The profile is the company's own declared record (facts Trooth observed are labeled as such) and is not signed: the one signed object is the witness statement, which `trooth verify` checks. Printed with exit 0 (found), 1 (no published record: found false, sections empty) or 6 (withheld: withheld true, sections empty). A usage, network or contract error prints the CLI's error document instead ({"ok": false, "error": "...", "exit": N}), as every command does.

subject.description: The domain the profile was read for: the domain given, or the domain of the record whose slug was given.

query.description: The domain, URL or Trooth slug as it was typed.

contract.description: The /api/network/profile contract version this CLI read.

read_at.description: When this CLI read the record, by this machine's clock, as an ISO 8601 date-time in UTC. It is not the date of any fact.

found.description: True when the Network holds a published record for the subject (including a withheld one). False is an honest absence: it says nothing about the company.

withheld.description: True when the record exists and is withheld while a report about it is reviewed; sections is then empty. Neither an absence nor a finding.

withheld_reason.description: Present when withheld: Trooth's own words on why, or null.

name.description: The company name as published, or null when no record was found.

slug.description: The company's slug on the Network, or null when no record was found.

record.description: Which record was read, as the projection states it.

signed.description: Always false: the profile is not signed. Trooth signs only the witness statement for a reading it took of the company's public surface.

verify_with.description: The command that checks the one signed object, the witness statement: trooth verify <domain>.

claim_url.description: When no record was found and the projection gives one, the address at which the company can claim its record; otherwise null. Never built by the CLI.

requested_sections.description: The section names --section asked for, in page order, or null for every section.

profile_present.description: True when the response carried the complete profile (the body's profile member). False when only the typed facts were carried: sections they do not cover are then unavailable.

sections.description: Every section the record carries, in the page's order, or those --section asked for. Empty when no record was found or it is withheld.

record.title: ProfileRecordRef

url.description: The company's public Trust Profile page, or null.

version.description: The Trooth-Record-Version response header, or null when the server did not state one.

digest.description: The Trooth-Record-Digest response header, or null.

updated_at.description: When the company last published a change to the record (the body's updatedAt), or null. It is the record's time, not a fact's.

record.description: Which record was read, as the projection states it: its page, the Trooth-Record-Version and Trooth-Record-Digest headers, and when the company last published a change.

section.title: ProfileSection
section.description: One section of the Trust Profile, as the record carries it.

name.description: The section name: overview, identity, history, funding, product, pricing, stack, security, privacy, ai, hosting, infrastructure, procurement, relationships, proof, people, documents, evidence, cards or faq, the names the MCP tool trooth_public_trust_profile takes; unsorted for typed facts whose category maps to none of them; or a section id the record adds later.

title.description: The section title as the page shows it.

state.description: published: the company shows content here. not_published: the company left it empty; printed "not published" and never filled in. hidden_by_company: the company chose not to show it; no values are carried. unavailable: Trooth could not read it on this load (or the response carried no profile); it is not empty. request_only: the content exists behind a request and is never carried.

provenance.description: Who said what is in this section, as the record labels it, or null when the record carries no label.

said_by.description: provenance in words, as the text output prints it.

meaning.description: What the record says to say about this section, or null.

url.description: The page that shows this section, or null.

facts.description: Every fact in the section, in the page's order: the section's fields, then each group's fields and items, then typed facts the page does not show. Empty for a section that is not published.

notes.description: The notes the record attaches to the section, its groups and its items.

fact.title: ProfileFact
fact.description: One fact: its value, who said it and its date when one is recorded.

value.description: The value as published, as text. A group item published by name only is one fact whose label is the group title and whose value is the item's name.

group.description: The group the fact is in, as the page titles it, or null for a section-level field. Other recorded facts marks a typed fact the page does not show.

item.description: The item within the group (for example one product or one sub-processor), or null.

provenance.description: Who said it: the typed fact's origin when the fact is joined to one, else the label of its group or section.

said_by.description: Who said it, in words (the company (declared), Trooth (observed), public source: <name>, ...).

key.description: The typed fact key (category.field, for example identity.legal-name) when the fact is joined to a typed fact with the same label and value in the same section; otherwise null.

origin.description: The typed fact's origin, or null when the fact is not joined to one.

source.description: Where the value can be read: the typed fact's sourceReference when there is one, else the page that shows the section.

date.description: The date Trooth recorded for this fact, as an ISO 8601 date-time: the typed fact's claim.declaredAt for a company declaration, else its claim.observedAt. Null when none is recorded (printed "date unknown"); never the record's update time, a reading's time or another fact's date.

date_kind.description: declared (claim.declaredAt) or observed (claim.observedAt); null when date is null.

contested.description: True when another source gave a different account of this fact; the accounts are listed, and Trooth does not choose between them.

accounts.description: When contested, each account with who gave it, in the record's fixed order, which is not a ranking. Empty otherwise.

signed.description: Always false: no fact is signed by anyone.

account.title: ProfileAccount
account.description: One source's account of a contested fact.

note.title: ProfileNote
note.description: A note the record attaches to a section, a group or an item.

group.description: The group the note belongs to, or null for a section note.

item.description: The item the note belongs to, or null.

text.description: The note, as the record words it.
